$what: Provenance of aurora-effects-scene.schema.json — empyrean's CONTRACT schema, vendored into Aurora beside the codec that validates against it. scene.ts imports the .json directly; this sidecar records where those bytes came from, and test/formats/effects-schema-drift.test.ts reads `empyrean.blob` from here as its pin of record.
$why_a_sidecar_and_not_only_a_test_const: Until 2026-08-29 the pinned blob hash lived as a `const PINNED_BLOB` in effects-schema-drift.test.ts and as prose in scene.ts's header and in effects-scene-golden.test.ts's header. Three copies, one of which (scene.ts) had already gone THREE re-pins stale without anything going red, because nothing hashes a comment. The hash now lives HERE, once, and the test reads it. The prose citations remain prose and say so.
$why_vendored: Aurora's core must validate from a lone clone, inside a git worktree (where ../../empyrean is not where it is from master), and in a packaged Electron build that ships no sibling repo. A path-probe design would degrade to 'schema not found -> skip validation', which is the loud-on-unmeasurable failure this suite is not allowed to have. The cost of vendoring is staleness; the drift gate and the currency check below are the payment. See docs/reviews/2026-08-28-golden-live-tree.md for the defect that made reading a peer's LIVE WORKING TREE unacceptable — this file is never read from ../empyrean at runtime or at test time by path, only through git objects at a named revision.
$why_not_under_test_fixtures: This is a SOURCE file the app imports, not a test fixture, so it lives beside its consumer. It is also deliberately outside test/fixtures/ because the published-revision sweep in test/formats/aeon-fixture-currency.test.ts walks that tree and reads every 40-hex on a `revision*` key as an AEON revision; an empyrean SHA sitting there would be checked for reachability from aeon's master and fail for a reason that has nothing to do with it.

what_changed_at_this_pin.cosmetic: None. 16 lines inserted, 0 deleted — the diff is exactly the two new nodes, unlike the drift re-pin below.
what_changed_at_this_pin.how_the_two_were_separated: A recursive diff of the two PARSED documents (bc639a10~1 vs bc639a10), key by key at every depth, reported exactly two differences: /properties/bob_shift and /properties/bob_period. Neither document was retyped; both were extracted with `git show`.
what_changed_at_this_pin.the_hazard_this_pin_carries: THE SENTINEL INVERTS AT THE LOWERING. The DOCUMENT key's off is bob_shift 15 (the house sentinel, the same 15 that means no deform on pcfg_anchor_dsa/dsb); the WIRE byte pcfg_bob's off is 0, because aeon's scene_bob_packed() folds an authored 15 into the packed byte 0 and otherwise emits (bob_shift << 4) | bob_period. Document-off and wire-off are OPPOSITE ENDS OF THE RANGE. A control clamped 0..15 authors 15 meaning MAXIMUM while the engine reads NO BOB; a control treating 0 as off authors the NARROWEST LEGAL SWAY, shift 0 being illegal precisely because it would pack to the no-bob byte. Both fields are also INVERSE shifts (bob_shift 1 = 128 px, 8 = 1 px; bob_period 0 = fastest, 8 = slowest), and bob_shift's domain is DISCONTINUOUS — 0 and 9..14 are refused by aeon's scene(). Aurora's control presents pixels and seconds over closed ladders with off as a separate state, so none of the three is reachable through the UI. ROADMAP row 99.
what_changed_at_this_pin.aurora_edits_this_pin_forced: (1) json-schema-subset.ts had to IMPLEMENT `anyOf` — the first in either committed contract schema, and the coverage gate in effects-schema-drift.test.ts went red naming it, which is that gate working as designed rather than an evaluator quietly ignoring a keyword. It is implemented as `anyOf` and NOT as its already-present neighbour `oneOf`, which would accept every value this schema means to accept today and silently refuse one if a future amendment let the arms overlap. (2) The shape-coverage golden test/fixtures/effects/canopy_dusk.json had to gain both keys, because effects-scene-golden.test.ts derives 'every declared top-level key is exercised' from the schema and went red naming them.
